Bulletin No: 01 LRA/26/02/21/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Heavy Rain
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 12.00 noon on 21 February 2026 valid for the period until 08.30 a.m. 22 February 2026
For Central, Uva and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in the Ampara, Batticaloa
and Polonnaruwa districts
PLEASE BE AWARE!
Due to the low level atmospheric
disturbance in the vicinity of Sri Lanka,
Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at
some places in Central, Uva and
Sabaragamuwa provinces and in the
Ampara, Batticaloa and Polonnaruwa
districts. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm
are likely at some places elsewhere.
Therefore, general public is advised to
take adequate precautions to minimize
damages caused by heavy rain, strong
winds and lightning during
thundershowers.
